title: GDScript Parsing Error: Missleading error message when overwriting static function
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.6.1.stable, 4.4.1.stable.mono

### System information

Godot v4.6.1.stable - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 3 monitors - Direct3D 12 (Mobile) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 9060 XT (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; 32.0.22029.9039) - AMD Ryzen 7 5700X 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 31.92 GiB memory

### Issue description

When overwriting a static function you have to match its signature.
When the base method is static and your overwriting method isn't, the error message gets confusing.

The resulting error looks like this:
Error at (3, 1): The function signature doesn't match the parent. Parent signature is "method(String) -> bool".

The error should show that the overwriting method needs to be static.


### Steps to reproduce

Start a new project and create the following scripts

test_base.gd
```gdscript
class_name TestBase

static func method(param:String) -> bool:
    return false
```

test_child.gd
```gdscript
class_name TestChild extends TestBase

func method(param:String) -> bool:
    return true
```

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[IssueTest.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26313035/IssueTest.zip)
